neighbours.label: The verb in the second half of a parallel construction that echoes the first half: 'the more people X, the more people ⟦rely⟧ on it', '..., or to ⟦attempt⟧ to do so'
fire: The more farmers depend on the canal, the more they rely on it to stay full.
It is forbidden to trap, poison or sell these animals, or to attempt to do so.
The more hospitals use the network, the more doctors rely on it to be fast.
No person may enter, damage or occupy the site, or attempt to do so at night.
The more children read at home, the more teachers rely on them to keep up.
It is an offence to forge, alter or copy a permit, or to attempt to do so.
The more cities grow, the more people rely on buses to get to work.
Nobody may remove, hide or destroy the records, or to attempt to do so again.
quiet: Farmers near the canal rely on it to stay full through the summer.
He made one attempt to trap the animals and then gave up.
Doctors in the hospital rely on the network to be fast.
Her first attempt to enter the site at night ended at the gate.
Teachers rely on parents to make sure the children keep up.
The clerk noticed the attempt to copy a permit and called the police.
People in large cities rely on buses to get to work.
Every attempt to destroy the records was stopped by the archivist.

notes: Card top examples are mixed (Awards, a link, approval, logic, attempt, rely); max is only 9.3. Probes: 'or to attempt to do so' 0.43 and 'the more we rely on it' 0.41, while 'an attempt to fix', 'tries to attempt', 'added a link to', 'approval for' all stayed under 0.07. The parallel-clause reading is a guess from those two hits.
